name: Dreaming
summary: Dreaming is OpenClaw's background memory consolidation: a scheduled job in the memory-core plugin reviews recent short-term notes and promotes durable items into MEMORY.md, with a readable diary in DREAMS.md. Listed as a pattern because the same idea ships under the same name elsewhere (Mem0 Dream, Honcho dreaming, Supermemory Dynamic Dreaming, Letta's memory and dreaming).
how: Collect short-term recall candidates from daily notes and sessions
Run a scheduled sweep (OpenClaw default: 3 AM daily)
Light and REM phases sort material and look for recurring themes
Deep phase scores candidates and promotes those passing thresholds into MEMORY.md
Write a diary of what was promoted for human review
facts: OpenClaw (memory-core); similar features in Mem0, Honcho, Supermemory, Letta
Keeps MEMORY.md curated, but adds a model call per sweep and can promote the wrong things
goodFor: Keeping a curated file from going stale
watchOut: Promotions happen without the user asking; review DREAMS.md
Extra model cost on each scheduled run
